pageTitle: Blind Spot Interval: spaced review reminders for students
demoSoon: This topic needs another review soon.

faqTopicAnswer: Something you studied and want to remember, such as the chain rule.
faqReviewAnswer: Explain the topic from memory. Check your notes, then rate what you remembered.
faqDatesAnswer: Your ratings help set the next review date. We look for a time inside your study hours.
faqCalendarAnswer: No. You can see all your reviews in the app.
faqLoginAnswer: Your Google account lets you return to your saved topics and reviews.
rightTime: Reviewing at the right time is how you beat it.
intro: Add a topic you just learned. Blind Spot Interval picks the best days to review it, so it sticks.
stepAddCopy: Type a name, like Chain rule. That is all it needs.
stepReviewCopy: We schedule it inside your study hours. Reviews appear on Today and, if you want, in Google Calendar.
stepRateCopy: Try to explain it from memory, then rate how it went. Easy topics come back later. Hard ones come back sooner.
benefitTime: Short sessions. The default review is 15 minutes.
benefitHours: Fits your day. Reviews land inside the study hours you set.

connectChatgptRequirement: ChatGPT web supports this in eligible workspaces. Custom setup may require administrator or owner permissions. Pro accounts have read-only options.
connectClaudeRequirement: Custom connectors depend on your plan. Team and Enterprise members may need the workspace owner to add the connector first.
connectGeminiRequirement: Use Gemini on the web with Gemini Apps Developer Mode available in your account. Blind Spot Connect has not been verified as a published Gemini app.
connectOtherRequirement: Check that your assistant supports a remote server with Streamable HTTP, OAuth authorization code and S256 PKCE. Ask your Blind Spot administrator for an approved public client or registered callback.
connectChatgptStep1: In ChatGPT on the web, open Plugins, select +, and choose Add custom MCP server.
connectChatgptStep2: Name it Blind Spot, paste the address below, and select OAuth. Ask your administrator to approve the exact callback shown by ChatGPT if needed.
connectChatgptStep3: Create the plugin and follow the sign-in prompt when connecting it or first using a tool.
connectClaudeStep1: In Claude, open Customize → Connectors, select Add, and choose Add custom connector.
connectClaudeStep2: Name it Blind Spot and paste the address below. Choose sign-in and automatic registration if your administrator has enabled it, or use an approved public client.
connectClaudeStep3: Add the connector, choose Connect if prompted, and approve the permissions in Blind Spot.
connectGeminiStep1: In Gemini on the web, open Settings → Gemini Apps Developer Mode and choose Create new.
connectGeminiStep2: Paste the address below. Use dynamic client registration only if your administrator has approved the Gemini callback for this setup.
connectGeminiStep3: Review the connection notice, choose Connect, then name the app and follow any Blind Spot authorization prompt.
connectOtherStep1: Find your assistant’s setting for adding a remote integration.
connectOtherStep2: Enter the address below and use OAuth with the public client or registration method approved by your administrator.
connectOtherStep3: Follow the assistant’s sign-in prompt and choose your permissions in Blind Spot.
connectAdvancedHint: Use this address only when your assistant asks for a remote server URL.
